messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: 502/504 spike detected on api-gateway-us-west-2 (5min > 7% 5xx, latency p95 > 2.5s). On-call: Olivia. Paging due to customer-impacting errors.
Olivia: seeing it on the dashboard, huge jump in 502s from edge -> gateway. Starting live triage. :eyes:
Olivia: quick check — are we in the middle of a rollout? Anyone touching gateway configs in the last hour?
Ravi: I didn't deploy anything. I see a canary job for nginx-conn-tuning completed ~45m ago (eng-runtime), but it was a small config. Tagging @eng-runtime.
Elena: I rolled a tiny routing change for internal traffic earlier but it was to a different cluster. Not us.
Marcus: I can standby and help with routing/fallbacks. Marcus taking over if Olivia needs handoff.
Olivia: running quick curl against edge -> responses 502 intermittently.
Olivia: ```
$ curl -v https://api.redwood.example.com/health
* Connected to api.redwood.example.com (54.23.12.45) port 443 (#0)
> GET /health HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.redwood.example.com
> 
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< content-type: application/json
< 
{"error":"upstream timeout"}
```
Ravi: logs show upstream timeouts from gateway to origin pool: "upstream read timeout (110)" across many nodes.
Olivia: what about connection pools? Any saturation on envoy side?
Marcus: checking metrics — connection_established near limit on gateway pool, connection_wait_seconds spiking. Looks like connection pool exhaustion.
Olivia: that would explain 504s too. Are we seeing a sudden traffic pattern change? Any customer campaigns?
cs-bot: FYI — 3 customers reported increased 502s via support in last 10m: AcmeCorp, Flowlytics, BrightDesk.
Olivia: Action plan: 1) enable routing fallback to secondary origin pool 2) increase gateway upstream timeout temporarily 3) scale gateway nodes 4) disable new canaries 5) collect heap and conn stats. Doing steps in parallel.
Marcus: I'll flip routing fallback and bump upstream_timeout to 10s on the edge config via hot-reload. Pushing now. :hammer_and_wrench:
Marcus: applied fallback rule to send 30% of traffic to secondary origin pool and bumped upstream timeout to 10s. Monitoring.
Olivia: good. I'm increasing max connections per worker on gateway to reduce wait. Applying config across the pool.
Ravi: rolling out conn config to 30% of gateways, will ramp.
Elena: pausing the nginx-conn-tuning rollout immediately. Cancelling remaining canaries.
incident-bot: Deploy cancel event recorded for nginx-conn-tuning by Elena at 2201122378.
Olivia: immediate synthetic tests:
Olivia: ```
$ for i in {1..10}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s\n" https://api.redwood.example.com/health; done
200 0.086s
200 0.092s
502 0.440s
200 0.081s
200 0.088s
```
Olivia: still intermittent but success rate improving after fallback. 5xx rate down from 7% -> 2.3% over 2 minutes.
Marcus: scaling gateway ASG +2 instances now. Expected to be in service ~2m.
Ravi: collecting tcpdump from one of the affected gateway nodes and tailing origin logs. Seeing many SYNs but then RSTs from origin due to backlog.
Elena: origin pool CPU spiking on a subset of instances — looks like one origin subset had a background job that consumed threads. Suspect degraded origin capacity.
Olivia: marking customer-impacting: yes. Notifying support and account execs.
cs-bot: Notified AcmeCorp and BrightDesk via template message.
Marcus: gateway scale up completed, new instances healthy. 5xx rate trending down to 0.9%. :thumbsup:
Olivia: keeping the increased upstream timeout and routing fallback for now. Need origin team to remediate the background job and drain affected instances.
Ravi: origin team alerted, draining two bad instances from the origin autoscaling group. Draining and replacing.
Elena: origin background job was a logrotate mishap that locked resources. Fixed and restarted. Draining shows steady connections now.
Olivia: after origin drain and fixes, 5xx down to 0.2% and p95 latency back to normal. Deploys remain paused.
Marcus: starting to roll back the temporary changes in a controlled manner: remove fallback (40% -> 0) and restore upstream timeout to 5s in 5-min window. Will monitor.
Olivia: agreed. Leave one extra instance in gateway pool until we've had 30m of stable metrics.
incident-bot: Incident acknowledged by Olivia. Severity: SEV2. Start time: 2201122334. Current status: mitigating.
Olivia: Handoff to Marcus for 30m post-mitigation watch. If metrics stay stable, we'll close in 45m. Marcus, you're on-call owner.
Marcus: taking over. Action items: 1) monitor 5xx for 30m 2) ensure ASG doesn't autoscale down prematurely 3) coordinate with origin to confirm fixed instances healthy.
Ravi: saved full tcpdump and uploaded to /var/incident/2201122334/tcpdump.pcap.gz and origin logs to /var/incident/2201122334/origin-logs.tar.gz.
Olivia: thanks team. Great quick triage. Postmortem to follow with timeline and root cause (origin job + connection pool exhaustion + coincident config canary). :clap:
cs-bot: Logged impacted customers and start post-incident comms draft.
Marcus: I'll take notes and start the postmortem doc after the 30m watch. Closing active pager. :white_check_mark:
